# `P_Ω` is generated by `Z(F)^0` and the non-negative affine root groups

For `P : ParahoricBuildingData G` with `hP : P.SatisfiesApartmentAxioms` and any
`Ω : Set P.Apartment`, the theorem
`ParahoricBuildingData.parahoric_eq_nonnegativeRootSubgroup` proves

```text
P.parahoric Ω = P.nonnegativeRootSubgroup Ω.
```

Here `P.parahoric Ω` is `Z(F)^0 ⊔ G(F)^♯_Ω` (KP Definition 7.4.1), with
`G(F)^♯_Ω = P.sharpFixer Ω` generated by the groups
`U_{a,Ω,0} = P.rootFixer a Ω`. The right-hand side is the existing Library
subgroup generated by `Z(F)^0` and the groups `U_ψ = P.affineRootGroup a ψ` for
`ψ ∈ P.affineRoots` with derivative `rootForm P.i a` and `ψ(x) ≥ 0` for all
`x ∈ Ω`. No boundedness or non-emptiness of `Ω` is assumed. The field, the group
scheme and the building data have an arbitrary universe `u`.

This is the form of KP Lemma 7.4.4(3) needed for the parahoric subgroup
`P_Ω = Z(F)^0 · G(F)^♯_Ω`. The module proves the inclusion
`G(F)^♯_Ω ⊆ P.nonnegativeRootSubgroup Ω` (`sharpFixer_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup`).
It does not state KP's exact equality of `G(F)^♯_Ω` with the subgroup generated
by the `U_ψ` alone, because the Library subgroup also contains `Z(F)^0`.

## Declarations

* `AffineRootSystem.IsAffineRootSystemWithRankZero.exists_le_apply`: for an affine
  root system `Ψ`, `ψ ∈ Ψ`, a point `x` and `M : ℝ`, some `θ ∈ Ψ` has
  `θ.linear = ψ.linear` and `M ≤ θ x`.
* `ParahoricBuildingData.affineRootGroup_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup`: a generator
  `U_ψ` (with `ψ ∈ Ψ`, derivative `a`, non-negative on `Ω`) lies in
  `P.nonnegativeRootSubgroup Ω`.
* `ParahoricBuildingData.mem_affineRootGroup_reflectionFunctional`: for
  `u ∈ U_a(F)`, `u ≠ 1`, `u ∈ U_ψ` with `ψ = P.reflectionFunctional a u`
  (the functional `ψ^u_a` with value `x_a(u)` at each point `x`).
* `ParahoricBuildingData.affineRootGroup_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup_of_not_double`:
  if `2b ∉ Φ`, `φ` has derivative `b` and `φ ≥ 0` on `Ω`, then
  `U_φ ≤ P.nonnegativeRootSubgroup Ω`. Here `φ` is any affine functional.
* `ParahoricBuildingData.affineRootGroup_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup_of_double`:
  the same conclusion when `2a ∈ Φ`, assuming `P.SatisfiesApartmentAxioms`.
* `ParahoricBuildingData.rootFixer_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup` and
  `ParahoricBuildingData.sharpFixer_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup`: `U_{a,Ω,0}` and
  `G(F)^♯_Ω` lie in `P.nonnegativeRootSubgroup Ω`.
* `ParahoricBuildingData.parahoric_eq_nonnegativeRootSubgroup`: the main theorem.
* `ParahoricNonnegativeRootGenerationStatement`: the proposition that for every
  nonarchimedean local field `F` and affine group scheme `G` over `F` in universe `u`,
  every `P : ParahoricBuildingData G` with `P.SatisfiesApartmentAxioms`, and every
  `Ω : Set P.Apartment`, `P.parahoric Ω = P.nonnegativeRootSubgroup Ω`. It has the
  same binders as the Library target `RootGroupActionAxiomStatement`.
* `parahoricNonnegativeRootGeneration : ParahoricNonnegativeRootGenerationStatement.{u}`:
  its proof, applying the main theorem.

## Implemented proof

**Unboundedness of root fibers.** Suppose every `θ ∈ Ψ` with derivative
`ψ.linear` had `θ x < M`. Take a coroot `v` of `ψ` (`exists_isCoroot`), so
`ψ.linear v = 2` and `θ - θ.linear v • ψ ∈ Ψ` for `θ ∈ Ψ`. For `θ` in the fiber,
`-(θ - 2ψ) = 2ψ - θ` lies in `Ψ` (`neg_mem`) and has the same derivative, so
`2ψ x - θ x < M` as well. Since `θ - ψ` is constant, `|θ y - ψ y|` is bounded by
`|M - ψ x|` at every `y`. So the whole fiber lies in the finite set of
`finite_bounded`, contradicting `infinite_fiber`.

**Generators.** `affineRootGroup_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup` puts `U_ψ` in the
generating set of the closure, the right term of the supremum.

**Roots `b` with `2b ∉ Φ`.** Take `u ∈ U_φ`, `u ≠ 1`. By
`mem_affineRootGroup_iff_reflectionFunctional`, `ψ = ψ^u_b` satisfies `φ ≤ ψ`
pointwise, so `ψ ≥ 0` on `Ω`, and `u ∈ U_ψ`. The element `u` is not in
`U_{ψ+}` (`mem_affineRootGroupPlus_iff` and `coe_reflectionFunctional_apply`
give `x_b(u) < x_b(u)`), so `U_{ψ+} ≠ U_ψ`. Since `2b` is not a root,
`KPApartmentData.mem_affineRoots_of_not_double_root` gives `ψ ∈ Ψ`, and `U_ψ` is
a generator.

**Roots `a` with `2a ∈ Φ`.** Let `H = P.nonnegativeRootSubgroup Ω`.

1. `4a ∉ Φ` by `KPApartmentData.no_quadruple_root_of_oppositePairs`, using the
   split torus and `ParahoricBuildingData.hasOppositeFactorPairs` (smoothness of
   `G` comes from `P.isConnectedReductive.smooth`).
2. AS3 (`hP.derivativeRoots_affineRoots`) gives some `ψ₁ ∈ Ψ` with derivative `a`.
   By the unboundedness lemma applied to `hP.isAffineRootSystem_affineRoots` at a
   point `x₀`, some `ψ_t ∈ Ψ` with derivative `a` satisfies `φ(x₀) ≤ ψ_t(x₀)`,
   hence `φ ≤ ψ_t` everywhere. So `ψ_t ≥ 0` on `Ω` and `U_{ψ_t} ≤ H`.
3. Suppose some `v₀ ∈ U_φ` is not in `H`. Call such elements bad. Every bad `v`
   is non-trivial with `φ ≤ ψ^v_a`, and `ψ^v_a(x₀) < ψ_t(x₀)`, since otherwise
   `v ∈ U_{ψ_t} ≤ H`. So `|ψ^v_a(x₀)|` is bounded by
   `max |φ(x₀)| |ψ_t(x₀)|`. By
   `ValuationBuildingData.finite_bounded_reflectionFunctionals_of_oppositePairs`,
   the set of functionals `ψ^v_a` of bad `v` is finite. `Set.exists_max_image`
   picks a bad `v` whose value `ψ^v_a(x₀)` is largest.
4. If `ψ := ψ^v_a ∈ Ψ`, then `v ∈ U_ψ ≤ H` is a contradiction. Otherwise
   `KPApartmentData.affineRootGroup_subset_mul_double_of_not_mem_affineRoots`
   writes `v = v' w` with `v' ∈ U_{ψ+}` and `w ∈ U_{2a, 2ψ}`. The functional `2ψ`
   has derivative `rootForm (2a)` (`rootForm_nsmul`) and is non-negative on `Ω`.
   Because `2(2a) ∉ Φ`, the case above gives `w ∈ H`.
5. If `v' = 1`, then `v = w ∈ H`, a contradiction. Otherwise
   `mem_affineRootGroupPlus_iff_reflectionFunctional` gives `ψ < ψ^{v'}_a`
   pointwise, so `v' ∈ U_φ`. Also `v' ∉ H`, since otherwise `v = v' w ∈ H`. So `v'`
   is bad with a strictly larger value at `x₀`, contradicting maximality.

**Assembly.** For `u ∈ U_{a,Ω,0}`, `u ≠ 1`, membership in each filtration
`x_a(u) ≥ 0` at `x ∈ Ω` (`mem_rootFixer`, `mem_filtration`) makes `ψ^u_a ≥ 0` on
`Ω`. Since `u ∈ U_{ψ^u_a}`, one of the two root cases gives `u ∈ H`. This proves
`rootFixer_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup`. `sharpFixer_le_nonnegativeRootSubgroup`
follows by `iSup_le`. Then `P.parahoric Ω ≤ H` follows from `sup_le`, since `Z(F)^0`
is the left term of `H`. The reverse inclusion is the existing
`nonnegativeRootSubgroup_le_parahoric`. `parahoricNonnegativeRootGeneration`
introduces the binders of the proposition and applies
`parahoric_eq_nonnegativeRootSubgroup`.

## Provenance and scope

The statement is KP Lemma 7.4.4(3) (Kaletha–Prasad, *Bruhat–Tits Theory: A New
Approach*, §7.4), transported to `P_Ω = Z(F)^0 · G(F)^♯_Ω`. KP's proof notes that
for multipliable `a` the groups `U_ψ`, `ψ ∈ Ψ_a ∪ Ψ_{2a}`, non-negative on `Ω`,
generate the same subgroup as those for `ψ ∈ Ψ'_a`. The descent argument in steps
3–5 is the internal derivation implementing that remark from the Library's
half-wall factorization and local finiteness of reflection functionals. The
unboundedness lemma is an internal consequence of the affine root system axioms
AR 2 (with its consequence `-Ψ = Ψ`) and AR 4 in their Library form. The module introduces no new
external assertion.
